acquisition.rate_limit_policy: Stop scheduling on 429/403, Retry-After, hash mismatch or unexpected failure. Drain at most two in-flight bounded requests; preserve all remaining document slots as not_attempted. No replacement.

evaluation.advance_rule: All three accuracy point differences nonnegative, shared-component mean 95% lower bound above zero, and ungated harm does not increase for any seed. One primary comparison; secondary metrics descriptive. Research advancement only.
evaluation.contrast_interpretation: Secondary descriptive evidence with actual group counts; no required semantic label or target support manufactured.
evaluation.contrasts: On source-isolated eligible pool, group by original-lemma basis, reading and coarse POS. At most 32 lemma/surface types per group. Deterministically select two different lemma/surface types, two examples each, with four distinct documents and bounded left contexts, per context_contrasts.py. At most 100 groups/400 rows. No converter/model outcome participates in selection.
evaluation.eligibility: Original morphemes only, reading 2..32 kana/long-vowel characters, surface 1..32 containing a CJK unified ideograph, preceding source context 8..64 characters within the same annotation unit. Exclude annotated alternatives and named entities. Preserve all exclusion counts and original annotations; no guessed readings or normalization.
evaluation.gate: Existing research margin >1.7 only; no calibration or threshold search.
evaluation.isolation: Complete previous 965889-node inventory plus all 10572 eligible inputs and all 3132 source units from the prior 1000-document experiment. Project old input hashes for leakage history only; do not feed their words/labels into the unchanged train cache. Add every new source unit and eligible input, rebuild forward/reverse closure.
evaluation.main: One target per document, minimum canonical SHA256 [20261106, loss-balance-main, stable_id] before candidates/models. Preserve all 615 terminal slots.
evaluation.metrics: Source-exact accuracy, rescue/harm/wrong-to-wrong, all failed corrections, error application/overall coverage, precision/recall, baseline gains, candidate presence/ranking failures, Wilson/exact 95% intervals and component paired bootstrap.
evaluation.models: All three new weighted fits, three immutable annotation controls, three immutable dictionary anchors, initial #29 reference; no best seed selection.
evaluation.primary: Mean of three paired weighted-minus-unweighted annotation seed accuracy differences on intact/ungated main, shared-component bootstrap 2000 draws seed20261106.
evaluation.rights: Research feasibility/evaluation only. No model training or redistribution from KWDLC. Provider's original-author permission and source-URL limitations remain unresolved.
evaluation.selection: All 615 remaining public-train documents, ordered by SHA256 [20261106, loss-balance-v1, document_id]. No replacement. Public dev/test excluded.
evaluation.shuffle: Fixed role/context-length stratified cyclic permutation, domain loss-balance-shuffle, seed20261106.

expected_cost: Approximately 3.5MB source transfer plus one full source-graph reconstruction and reverse replay; prior 1000-document graph cost 248s. Three fixed 500-update fits after readiness, CPU-only inference and 10000 runs per predesignated export. Hard stage bounds apply; actual costs recorded.
expected_effect: Unknown. The frozen train-derived weighting isolates one mixture effect; it may reduce harms while also losing rescues. Failure of the primary rule retains the existing model.
hypothesis: Matching Aozora baseline-correct/error loss contribution reduces broad unnecessary changes while retaining useful repairs on unused sources; source rows, model, initial weights and exposure stay fixed.
quality_policy: Existing source-reconstruction permission only. No new label admissions, independent IME Gold or source licensing changes.

training.loss: Unchanged C2 smoothed listwise per-example CE, multiplied by fixed source/baseline-correctness weights, then arithmetic batch mean. Never divide by random batch weight sum.
training.start_rule: Only after fresh source isolation, candidate/numeric verification, at least 500 main rows, loss/weight tests and a separately committed fit binding. No fits if readiness fails.
training.weight_derivation: Match the old Aozora correct/error prevalence while preserving expected total Aozora loss mass and all rows. No evaluation-dependent coefficient search.
